giraffe.q: A giraffe's tongue is dark purple. True or false?
giraffe.why: A giraffe's tongue is dark purple, blue or black, and about half a metre long! Scientists think the dark colour may protect it from sunburn while it eats leaves all day.
giraffe.try: Try it: stick out your tongue in a mirror. What colour is yours? 👅

butterfly.q: A butterfly tastes with its feet. True or false?
butterfly.why: Butterflies have tiny taste sensors on their feet. When a butterfly lands on a flower or a leaf, it can taste it just by standing on it! Mother butterflies even drum on leaves with their feet to find the right plant for their eggs.
butterfly.try: Try it: at snack time, find one food that tastes sweet, one salty and one sour. Which part of you did the tasting? 👅
